The '''wedding of Varner Hilts and Iliano Merko''' allowed [[Iliana Hilts|Iliana Merko]], leader of the [[Sisters of Seelah]], to share [[Varner Hilts|Hilts']] power over the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Tribe]].<ref name="Secrets" /> Hilts ensured that she would not try to usurp his [[Grand Lord|throne]] because upon his [[Death/Legends|death]] his [[Grand Consort|spouse]] would also be killed, a tradition [[Yaru Korsin]] had begun.<ref name="Purgatory">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Purgatory]]''</ref> They later had a daughter, [[Takara Hilts]], who would be involved in [[Dreypa's rebellion]] twenty five years [[2975 BBY|later]]<ref name="Spiral">''[[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral]]''</ref>.
